import FreeCAD as App, Part, Sketcher
from FreeCAD import Vector as V
doc = App.ActiveDocument or App.newDocument("Outline")
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
xz = [o for o in body.Origin.OriginFeatures if o.Role == "XZ_Plane"][0]
sk = body.newObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")
sk.AttachmentSupport = (xz, [""])
sk.MapMode = "FlatFace"
doc.recompute()
pts = [(0,0),(25,0),(25,10),(20,10),(20,5),(5,5),(5,60),(0,60)]
n = len(pts)
for i in range(n):
    a, b = pts[i], pts[(i+1) % n]
    sk.addGeometry(Part.LineSegment(V(a[0],a[1],0), V(b[0],b[1],0)), False)
for i in range(n):
    sk.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint("Coincident", i, 2, (i+1) % n, 1))
doc.recompute()
pad = body.newObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
pad.Profile = sk
pad.Length = 20
doc.recompute()
sk.Visibility = False
bb = pad.Shape.BoundBox
print(pad.Shape.isValid(), pad.Shape.Volume, bb)

import FreeCAD as App
doc = App.ActiveDocument
print("Document:", doc.Name)
print("--- Model tree ---")
def walk(o, d=0):
    print("  "*d + f"{o.Label} ({o.TypeId})")
    for c in getattr(o, "Group", []):
        walk(c, d+1)
for o in doc.Objects:
    if not o.InList:
        walk(o)
body = doc.getObject("Body")
pad = doc.getObject("Pad"); sk = doc.getObject("Sketch")
s = pad.Shape
bb = s.BoundBox
print("--- Measurements ---")
print("BoundBox X: %.3f..%.3f (%.3f)" % (bb.XMin, bb.XMax, bb.XLength))
print("BoundBox Y: %.3f..%.3f (%.3f)" % (bb.YMin, bb.YMax, bb.YLength))
print("BoundBox Z: %.3f..%.3f (%.3f)" % (bb.ZMin, bb.ZMax, bb.ZLength))
print("Volume: %.3f mm^3" % s.Volume)
print("Surface area: %.3f mm^2" % s.Area)
print("CoM:", s.CenterOfMass)
print("Faces/Edges/Vertices:", len(s.Faces), len(s.Edges), len(s.Vertexes))
print("Sketch profile area: %.3f, perimeter: %.3f" % (Part.Face(Part.Wire(sk.Shape.Edges)).Area if False else 0, sk.Shape.Length))
print("Sketch geometry:")
for i,g in enumerate(sk.Geometry):
    print(" ", i, g.StartPoint, "->", g.EndPoint, "len=%.2f" % g.length())
print("Pad: Length=%s Type=%s Reversed=%s Midplane=%s" % (pad.Length, pad.Type, pad.Reversed, pad.Midplane))
print("Sketch support:", sk.AttachmentSupport, sk.MapMode, "Placement:", sk.Placement)
